 Order

T his third application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.276/2022 registered at Police Station Lanjhi, District Balaghat, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 408, 467, 468, 471, 472, 34 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code.

T he applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 12.10.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.45283 of 2022 and second bail application was also dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01.11.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.50846 of 2022.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that looking to the period of custody and allegations made against the present applicant by placing the forged bills of diesel.
The present applicant being a police person has withdrawn the amount and mis-appropriated the government fund.
He submits that charge-sheet has been filed, he is in custody from 27.08.2022 and amount can also be recovered from the applicant by initiating the disiplinary proceedings.
Therefore, he prays that considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the applicant's custody period, he may be enlarged on bail.

On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that the applicant is holding the post of constable and it is not expected from him to commit such type of crime, therefore, he is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.

I t is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
